Who filed the 16.10 lakh ECI appeals seeking deletion of included voters in West Bengal, and under whose authority. Sandhu asked in Aug 2026; the ECI's Sep 2026 Supreme Court filing does not say.

Senior officers of 2019-2024 are thinly covered: Umesh Sinha (Secretary General; Section 126 committee report, Jan 2019), Sudeep Jain and other DECs in the 2019 VVPAT case, DECs during the 2024 turnout-data and Form 17C dispute, and Ashok Lavasa-era Secretariat roles. The search budget ran out before these could be sourced. Start with ECI press notes (eci.gov.in API get-file) and Supreme Court records.
The Secretary General post: no Secretary General appears in the Sep 2026 ECI directory, and when the post was last filled was not established.
Service records (cadre, batch, postings) for ECI secretariat officers Pawan Diwan and Pramod Kumar Sharma, and for Nitesh Kumar Vyas, were not found.
Seema Khanna's own account: she did not answer the Indian Express questionnaire, and no statement from her on ERO access or the Goa rollback was found.

Maharashtra CEO's June 2025 clarification and the Karnataka CEO office letters of 4 Feb and 14 Mar 2025 are known only from press accounts. The primary texts are on ceoelection.maharashtra.gov.in and in Congress's September 2025 releases.
Whether any officer was answerable for the 97 Goa voters left off the roll, and whether the ECINet rollback was ever built. No ECI statement addresses it.
